'''Valhoun's Vultures''' was an infamous special tactics squad of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that operated by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They blew up an ammo supply and wiped out an entire Imperial Battalion on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They also sabotaged an Imperial shipyard near [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="Minefield" />

A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]-aligned official was tasked by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Drexel (sergeant)|Drexel]] to eliminating the team after losing a squad of his [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to the Vultures that lured them into a [[Mine/Legends|minefield]].<ref name="Minefield" />
